        tx, ty = _zone_center(sandbox, next_switch)
        dx = tx - x
        dy = ty - y
        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        fx = GAIN_NORMAL * dx - APPROACH_DAMP * vx
        fy = GAIN_NORMAL * dy - APPROACH_DAMP * vy
        mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
        if mag > mf:
            fx, fy = fx * mf / mag, fy * mf / mag
        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
        return

    # If next is C, ensure altitude is met
    if next_switch == "C" and _max_y_history[0] < ALTITUDE_THRESHOLD:
        y_target = 3.5
        dy = y_target - y
        fx = 0.0
        fy = GAIN_NORMAL * dy - APPROACH_DAMP * vy
        mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
        if mag > mf:
            fx, fy = fx * mf / mag, fy * mf / mag
        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
        return

    # In ramp region, apply vertical assist
    in_ramp = RAMP_X_LO <= x <= RAMP_X_HI
    use_ramp = in_ramp and (next_switch == "B" or (next_switch == "C" and x < bx))
    if use_ramp:
        y_target = 3.3
        dy = y_target - y
        fx = min(mf * 0.7, 35.0) * (1.0 if dx > 0 else 0.7) - RAMP_DAMP * vx
        fy = RAMP_Y_GAIN * dy - RAMP_DAMP * vy
        mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
        if mag > mf:
            fx, fy = fx * mf / mag, fy * mf / mag
        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
        return

    # Apply normal approach logic
    if dist < APPROACH_RADIUS:
        force_mag = min(mf * 0.8, GAIN_APPROACH * dist)
        ux, uy = (dx / dist, dy / dist) if dist > 1e-6 else (0, 0)
        fx = force_mag * ux - APPROACH_DAMP * vx
        fy = force_mag * uy - APPROACH_DAMP * vy
        mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
        if mag > mf:
            fx, fy = fx * mf / mag, fy * mf / mag
        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
        return

    force_mag = min(mf, GAIN_NORMAL * dist)
    ux, uy = (dx / dist, dy / dist) if dist > 1e-6 else (0, 0)
    fx = force_mag * ux - 0.5 * vx
    fy = force_mag * uy - 0.5 * vy
    mag = math.hypot(fx, fy)
    if mag > mf:
        fx, fy = fx * mf / mag, fy * mf / mag
    sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
